protocol.a: Exact normalized full catalog/source name orpolygon IoU>=0.98, plus explicit reviewed same-place membership/alias decisions. Canonical equal-area survivor prefers released identity then relation then stable ID. Distinct named sibling layouts excluded.
protocol.b: Explicit non-course name/tag, plus individually reviewed practice-center source. Playable par-three/academy layouts are not non-course components.
protocol.c: Contained separate layout, reusing reviewed existing course ID. Unresolved identity/scope conflicts remain unchanged. No booking/arrival inference.
protocol.d: Only reviewed exact same-name way/relation strict partial pairs. No relation/relation, fuzzy names, or overlap-percentage broadening.
protocol.e: The 14 reported unique point-to-existing-course matches, inclusive 2 km haversine to stored parent display position. Unicode NFKD/casefold/combining-mark and intra-word-apostrophe removal; other punctuation to spaces. Exact names/literal composites; onlyState Park / Course suffix variant. No broader descriptors.
protocol.bethpage: Specific approved identity exception tojoin composite area into existing five-course facility; no extra course.
